objective: Separate verified fresh installation from repeatable Program-only upgrades, preserving instance state and closing public installer integrity gaps.
boundaries: Public deployment scripts/tests only. No private Rust changes, hwlinux use, Actions, runtime Release upload or pointer movement. Docker mutations restricted to ddtry and explicitly owned disposable fixtures on hwbluebwsl. Preserve ddtry data, credentials, configuration and exposure.

claims.value: public install plan/helper, novice installer, product CLI, scoped smoke guards and related tests/docs
ddtry on hwbluebwsl; isolated public-repo test worktree on m4mac

validation: exact controller file hashes and target/source evidence
resume_point: Integrate fetched ready workstream after verifying unchanged main target; revalidate merged tree, push, and perform fresh public-main CLI check/upgrade replay without version overrides.
retention: Retain remote workstream and sanitized evidence, reclaim only owned development worktrees and disposable WSL fixtures after verified integration. Keep ddtry and its verified foundation.
